title: Test writer
skill: Show the agent the exact shape you want

good: Write tests for parse_duration() in duration.py. Put them in tests/test_duration.py, using unittest (no pytest here), one TestCase class, and start the file like tests/test_smoke.py (sys.path insert). Cover: each unit alone ('2h' == 7200, '5m' == 300, '9s' == 9); combinations ('1h30m' == 5400, '1h2m3s' == 3723); spaces and upper case (' 1H 30M ' == 5400); zero ('0s' == 0). Use assertRaises(ValueError) for: empty or only spaces, unknown unit '5d', units out of order '30m1h', a repeated unit '1h2h', and trailing text '10m5'. Do not change duration.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Write some tests for the duration parser.
